participants.note: asked whether the logging interface is vulnerable to format string attacks
warned that wholesale rejection of newlines would break multiline logs like exceptions and wallet commit transactions
pointed out tor and i2p log injections and supported global newline escaping
tested wallet and RPC behaviors, re-ACKed updated escaping approach
critiqued call-site sanitization and out-of-scope wallet name changes, later approved central escaping

claims.harm: Wholesale blocking of newlines silently breaks existing multiline logs such as exceptions and wallet commit transactions
claims.quote: Sure, but this will silently break logs, as explained above.
claims.settled_by_quote: Intentional multiline logs use the new `SplitLines` (rewritten slightly and covered with tests).

claims.harm: Sanitizing strings at RPC call sites strips non-newline characters and produces confusing or misleading warnings
claims.quote: It doesn't seem ideal to use SanitizeString string here because this strips characters other than newlines, and produce confusing / misleading warnings
claims.settled_by_quote: rebased and replaced RPC-specific sanitization with global newline escaping, preserving printable method characters.

claims.harm: Restricting wallet names to prevent log injection introduces out-of-scope wallet validation logic into a logging PR
claims.quote: I do think it would be a little better to drop the two wallet commits here... and only keep the logging commits
claims.settled_by_quote: updated to focus on logging, dropped the wallet-name restrictions

support.reason: Favored global newline escaping to also protect arbitrary strings from tor control and i2p daemons
Manually verified wallet name validation and RPC log injection prevention
Code review ACKed earlier approach while proposing central newline escaping in Logger::Format and SplitLines
Approved the central newline escaping implementation as simpler and protective against external daemon injection paths

result.notes: All objections regarding multiline log breakage, RPC string sanitization side-effects, and wallet scope creep were resolved by adopting central newline escaping with SplitLines and dropping the wallet commits. The PR has multiple ACKs across revisions.
